context.transcript:
Good morning.
How can I help you?
Hi.
I heard you sell wall petitions here.
Several new people are starting at my company next week, so I received a maintenance request to rearrange the office space so that everyone can work comfortably.
Sure.
Here are the types we carry in the store.
We have many sizes of freestanding barriers.
Do you know what you're looking for?
Well, I definitely want something that can be moved around easily.
All the wall partitions are on wheels.
That way, if your needs change, you can reuse the same panels in a different way.
Oh, great.
In that case, can I see what the tallest option looks like?
Thank you.
Thank you.
context.transcript_translation:
早上好。
请问有什么可以帮您？
嗨。
我听说这里卖墙隔断板的。
我们公司下周有几位新员工入职，所以我收到了一个维护请求，需要重新布置一下办公室空间，让每个人都能舒适地工作。
好的。
这是我们店里携带的类型。
我们有很多尺寸的独立屏障。
你知道你在找什么吗？
嗯，我确定想要一些可以轻松移动的东西。
所有的墙隔断板都是带轮子的。
这样的话，如果你的需求改变了，你可以用不同的方式重复使用这些面板。
哦，太棒了。
在这种情况下，我可以看看最高的选项是什么样的吗？
谢谢您。
谢谢您。
